register.labelZh: SORT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: sort somebody out 是非正式表達,可表示對付或懲治惹麻煩的人。這個說法有時帶有威嚇意味,因此必須留意情境和語氣。；sort somebody out with something 可以用來表示為別人提供衣物、門票、食物、房間或其他所需物品。；sort itself out 可以表示一個問題或混亂情況無須別人處理,便自然得到解決。；sort through something 適合用來描述逐一查看衣物、文件、照片、訊息或其他物件的過程。
register.summaryEn: Sort somebody out is an informal expression used when someone intends to deal firmly with or punish a person who has caused trouble. It can sound aggressive, so the situation and tone are important. Sort somebody out with something can be used when providing clothes, tickets, food, a room or another item that someone needs. Sort itself out expresses the idea that a problem or confusing situation becomes settled naturally. Sort through something is useful when examining clothes, papers, photographs, messages or other items one by one.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. In SORT... OUT expressions, place words such as him, her, us, them and itself between SORT and OUT: sort him out sort them out with tickets sort itself out Sort somebody out and sort somebody out with something have very different meanings. The first can mean dealing with or punishing a troublesome person. The second means providing someone with something they need.
